title: TWITTER R10pro current carbon platform specifications
notes: Current manufacturer R10pro platform page specifies a high-modulus-carbon frame, fork and seatpost. The retained closed-wheel Gen 3 official-store listing is exact to R10pro and its WheelTop EVO or Shimano 105 R7120 options, but no primary source exposes a generation-specific carbon grade, lay-up or stiffness protocol; those details are not inferred from older R10pro trims.
